owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to main.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to main as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.
The verifier never controls its own trust boundary: contract, evidence and gate records change only through the owner deploy key.
Heuristic checks are one layer, never a boundary; say so in every receipt and page.
No reliability or enterprise claim without a gated task behind it (TB-08).
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | missing.

tasks.title: A contract change commits only with the owner's approval marker for its exact bytes
tasks.description: The pre-commit hook (src/index.mjs hookPreCommit, src/contract.mjs weakenings) keeps refusing a staged proofline.json whose weakenings against HEAD are not empty. The one path through it is an approval marker written by the owner: a file named <approvals directory>/<sha256 hex of the staged proofline.json bytes>. The approvals directory is set per clone with `proofline init --approvals <dir>` (re-runnable) and kept in .proofline/config.json, which is never committed; with no directory configured every contract change is refused. The refusal message prints the weakenings, the sha256 of the staged bytes and the marker path that would approve them, so the proposal can be posted and approved by hash. A marker whose name is not the sha256 of the staged bytes does not count, and what else the commit stages makes no difference: a commit of proofline.json alone without a marker is refused, a commit of proofline.json beside code with the marker passes. `gate` and the report keep showing contract_change against the base. Follow-up outside this task: once @optitransfer/agentkey ships signing (AK-03), the marker content becomes an agentkey signature over the hash, verified against the owner key named in the contract. Red on the parent: with the marker present for a changed criterion command, `proofline hook pre-commit` still refuses, because no marker logic exists.

criteria.statement: with the marker for the staged bytes present, a contract change (changed criterion command) is refused on the parent and passes on the head; without a marker, or with a marker named for other bytes, it is refused on the head whatever else is staged; proofline.json beside a code file with the marker passes
the refusal names the hash and the marker path

verifier.why: the message is what the owner approves by
a user must know how a contract change is approved

stop_rules: No bypass variable and no approval by staged-set shape; if the marker cannot be bound to the exact staged bytes: STOP and report.

tasks.title: receipt command, contract mode, signed with agentkey
tasks.description: External dependency: @optitransfer/agentkey@next on npm (AK-02); if absent report BLOCKED. Export buildReceipt(opts) from src/receipt.mjs and call it from bin/proofline.mjs. New command `proofline receipt <TASK> [--role <role>] [--base <sha>] [--out <path>]`. Runs verify for the task and builds the predicate https://proofline.dev/receipt/v1 with the fields (level, producer, base, task, tests{changed, red_on_base{ran,failed,output_sha256}, green_on_head{ran,passed,output_sha256}}, suite{command,exit,count,duration_ms}, metrics[], scope{allowed,changed,pass}, forbidden{findings,pass}, claims{reported,reconciled}, agent{role,kid,run_id,model?,trace?}, memory?, timestamps). Subject: {name: "git+<remote url>@<ref>", digest:{gitCommit, gitTree}}. Signs with agentkey signDSSE for the role (default PROOFLINE_AGENT_ROLE, else level L0 unsigned). Writes .proofline/receipts/<sha7>.json (the envelope); init already ignores .proofline/ (src/index.mjs:24), and `proofline init --keep-receipts` adds the negation `!.proofline/receipts/` for teams that commit them. Subject name: "git+<remote url>@<ref>" for public repositories, "<ref>" with the repository only in predicate.repository for private ones. Subject binding rules every verifier applies: subject.gitCommit must equal the head being judged and predicate.base.gitCommit the base; a tree-only match marks base-relative fields (red_on_base, scope) unverified unless recomputed. tests.red_on_base and green_on_head carry attempts; suite carries reruns. Red means exit != 0 on base (a module-not-found counts), stated in docs. schema/receipt-v1.json is a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the predicate; the command validates against it before signing. Every boolean has a sibling `ran`.

criteria.statement: a fixture task yields a receipt whose predicate validates against schema/receipt-v1.json and whose envelope verifies with agentkey; red_on_base, green_on_head, suite, scope, forbidden, claims populated

tasks.description: Export verifyReceipt(envelopePath, opts) from src/verify-receipt.mjs; bin/proofline.mjs and the action call the same function. `proofline verify-receipt <envelope> [--keys <dir>] [--sigstore] [--recompute --base <sha>]`. tasks.title: Owner-signed contracts: every entry point refuses an unsigned or altered contract
tasks.description: External dependency: agentkey@next (AK-02). proofline.json gets a sibling proofline.json.sig: a DSSE envelope over sha256(canonical proofline.json) signed by the agentkey role "owner", whose private key exists only on the owner's machine; the owner public key is pinned in guard/owner.pub (a TB-01 protected path) and read from there, never from the contract. `proofline contract sign` (owner laptop) writes the signature; `proofline contract verify-sig` checks it; next, verify, gate, brief and both hooks exit 2 with "contract not owner-signed" when the hash has no valid signature. `proofline contract propose` writes proposals/<sha256>.diff and prints the hash; it is the only agent path. The weakening check stays as a warning. This replaces PL-00; the "stages only proofline.json" rule is removed.
